title: [E-Document] Remove Access = Internal from E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit
summary: The E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit access level is changed from Internal to public, allowing partners to reuse its functions for custom E-Document implementations.
key_points: Access = Internal removed from codeunit 6152 E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl.
Partners can now call its functions from their own E-Document implementations
A one-line change was also made in table 6139 E-Doc. Service Data Exch. Def.
No functional change to existing behavior
